response.original_title: 43 Years: A Little Ways More To Go
response.overview: This short documentary tells the powerful story of a 43-year separation between two sisters during the height of racism and racial division in the 1960s. Torn apart by the harsh realities of that era, their lives were forced down very different paths, yet faith, hope, and the belief that God would one day restore what was lost never faded.  Through decades of searching, praying, and holding onto God’s promises, this story unfolds as a moving testimony of perseverance, redemption, and divine faithfulness. What once seemed impossible becomes a powerful reminder that time, distance, and circumstance cannot cancel what God has spoken.  More than a story of reunion, this short documentary is a witness to the goodness of God. It reminds viewers that no matter the pain, the waiting, or the uncertainty, if we hold firmly to Him, He will never leave nor forsake us—and His promises will always be fulfilled.
response.title: 43 Years: A Little Ways More To Go
